paragraphs.text: Active exploitation of critical vulnerabilities in Cisco Expressway, VMware vCenter, WhatsApp for Android, and Linux KVM demonstrates rapid weaponization across communication, virtualization, and mobile platforms. Control owners should prioritize patch verification, network segmentation, and memory isolation testing for affected assets.

Confirmed breaches at Bell Canada and a third-party service provider exposing financial customer data reveal persistent supply chain and direct compromise risks in telecommunications and banking. Data protection and third-party risk owners must validate access controls on provisioning systems and supplier assurance evidence.
